segments.time: Night, warm sconce light on the elevator landing
segments.first_state: Camera on the front-wall side of the landing, at the stone-corridor end, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall; the axis runs from the painting's elevator side to the walnut front door. Ji Ran stands beneath the autumn landscape painting, on its elevator side, in her black satin slip dress, facing the walnut front door. Lin Qingyu stands close beside her, nearer the console table, in his white T-shirt and open black bomber jacket. His right arm is around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens hangs from his left hand. Lu Shaoze stands on the front-door side of the landing, a few paces in front of the tall walnut front door with the black smart lock, in his navy double-breasted suit over a black silk shirt, facing them. The brushed-steel elevator doors on the left wall are closed. There is one slim dark-wood console table under the painting, between two brass wall sconces.

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the stone-corridor end facing the painting on the back wall
shots.visual: Beneath the autumn landscape painting, Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran by the waist with the grocery bag of greens in his other hand. Lu Shaoze, on the front-door side, glares across the stone floor at his arm.
shots.audio: <Quiet corridor hush, paper bag rustles>

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze, in front of the walnut front door, jabs a finger at Lin Qingyu's arm around Ji Ran's waist, his face hard.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lu Shaoze, in Mandarin, sharp and contemptuous): {你谁啊，手拿开。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot composition, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the painting and the elevator doors
shots.visual: Under the painting, Lin Qingyu smiles brightly, slides his right arm off Ji Ran's waist and holds his right hand out toward the front door, the grocery bag still in his left hand. Ji Ran stays beside him.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, slow push in on Lin Qingyu, eye level, from the front-wall side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu keeps his hand extended toward Lu Shaoze's place by the front door, with a sunny, innocent grin.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Mandarin, cheerful and polite): {哟，你好。我是纪然男朋友，林青羽。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot, locked-off camera, eye level, over Lin Qingyu's shoulder toward the walnut front door
shots.visual: Over Lin Qingyu's shoulder, Lu Shaoze stares down at the offered hand and folds his arms without taking it.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Mandarin, sweet, teasing): {哎呀姐姐也真是的，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot composition, handheld camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu lowers his unshaken hand, turns his head to Ji Ran beside him under the painting and nudges her playfully. Ji Ran keeps her cool face toward the front door.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Mandarin, soft, whiny, mock reproach): {有客人来了，怎么不让进家门呢，站在门口说话呢。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, locked-off camera, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze unfolds his arms and steps one pace forward from the front door. He points at Lin Qingyu while looking at Ji Ran.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lu Shaoze, in Mandarin, indignant, rising): {纪然，我才是你的联姻对象，旁边这男的怎么回事啊？}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, dirty single, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting
shots.visual: Ji Ran folds her arms beneath the painting and answers with a flat, bored look, a sliver of Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the frame edge.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Mandarin, cool, clipped, deadpan): {我不都跟你说了吗，我已经有男朋友了，正准备结婚。}

shots.camera: Close-up, quick push in on Lu Shaoze's face, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the front door
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze's jaw clenches and his eyes widen in disbelief. His hands tighten into fists.

segments.light_audio: Warm light from the two brass wall sconces on the back wall and soft ceiling downlights on the pale stone floor; quiet corridor hush, paper bag rustle.

dialogue.speaker: lin_qingyu
dialogue.line: 哟，你好。我是纪然男朋友，林青羽。 哎呀姐姐也真是的，有客人来了，怎么不让进家门呢，站在门口说话呢。

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran

must_hit: Lin Qingyu, arm around Ji Ran's waist and holding the grocery bag, offers his hand to Lu Shaoze
Lu Shaoze refuses the handshake and demands who the man is
Ji Ran states she already has a boyfriend
segments.exit_state: Camera on the front-wall side of the landing, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall. Ji Ran stands beneath the painting on its elevator side, arms folded, facing the walnut front door. Lin Qingyu stands close beside her, nearer the console table, his arm no longer around her, the grocery bag full of greens in his left hand. Lu Shaoze stands one pace in front of the walnut front door, facing them, fists clenched. The brushed-steel elevator doors are closed.

segments.time: Night, warm sconce light on the elevator landing
segments.first_state: Camera on the front-wall side of the landing, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall. Ji Ran stands beneath the painting on its elevator side, arms folded, facing the walnut front door. Lin Qingyu stands close beside her, nearer the console table, his arm no longer around her, the grocery bag full of greens in his left hand. Lu Shaoze stands one pace in front of the walnut front door, facing them, fists clenched. The brushed-steel elevator doors are closed.

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze shakes his head hard and thumps his own chest, glaring at Ji Ran.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lu Shaoze, in Mandarin, shrill, disbelieving): {不可能！我们在一块四年，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, dirty single, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting
shots.visual: Ji Ran rolls her eyes and tilts her head beneath the painting, arms still folded, a sliver of Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the frame edge.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lu Shaoze, in Mandarin, smug, insistent): {你那么爱我，怎么可能跟别人在一块？}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on Ji Ran's face and shoulders, push in, eye level, from the front-wall side
shots.visual: Ji Ran lifts her chin and gives a dry, provoking half-smile toward the front door.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Mandarin, cool, mocking): {可我就是跟别人在一起了，怎么？你咬我啊？}

shots.camera: Medium shot, tracking with Lin Qingyu from beneath the painting toward the walnut front door, eye level, from the front-wall side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu steps across the stone floor until he stands in front of Lu Shaoze and peers at his face with fake concern, the grocery bag in his left hand.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Mandarin, sweet, falsely worried): {我看你脸色不太好，是不是身体哪里不舒服呀，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot in profile, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu pats Lu Shaoze's shoulder twice with his right hand, smiling innocently. Lu Shaoze stiffens, his back to the front door.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Mandarin, gentle, needling): {您年纪也不小了，要多注意身体，才行呀。}

shots.camera: Close-up insert on Lu Shaoze's shoulder, locked-off camera, eye level
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze knocks Lin Qingyu's hand off his shoulder with a swipe.
shots.audio: <Sharp slap of hand on hand>

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, handheld camera, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze points furiously from Lin Qingyu to Ji Ran, his face red, his mouth opening and closing without a word.
shots.audio: <Angry huff>

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the stone-corridor end facing the painting
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze turns on his heel and strides across the open stone floor past Ji Ran to the brushed-steel elevator doors. He jabs the button and storms in, and the doors close behind him. Lin Qingyu steps back beside Ji Ran beneath the painting.
shots.audio: <Elevator chime, doors slide shut>

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot composition, slow push in, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting
shots.visual: Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu turn their heads and exchange a look beneath the painting. Ji Ran's arms loosen.

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on Lin Qingyu's face, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu breaks into a wide, mischievous grin.

segments.light_audio: Warm light from the two brass wall sconces on the back wall and soft ceiling downlights; corridor hush, a slap, the elevator chime and the doors sliding shut.

segments.time: Dusk turning to night, deep blue and orange sky
segments.first_state: Camera on the overpass at the front side, facing down the multi-lane road toward its vanishing point between the two rows of glass office towers. The lanes are packed with traffic, white headlights coming toward the camera and red tail-lights going away. The rows of streetlights along both sidewalks are still dark.

shots.camera: Extreme wide shot, high angle from the overpass, slow push in toward the vanishing point between the towers
shots.visual: Dense traffic streams along the multi-lane road between glass office towers with lit windows, under a dusk sky.
shots.audio: <Distant traffic rumble, faint horns>

shots.camera: Wide shot, high angle, slow pan along the tree-lined sidewalk from the overpass
shots.visual: The streetlights flicker on one after another along both sidewalks as the sky darkens over the headlights.
shots.audio: <Traffic hum>

segments.light_audio: Dusk sky glow, streetlamps flickering on, white headlights and red tail-lights; city traffic rumble.
must_hit: Headlights pack the road between office towers
Streetlights come on as the sky darkens

segments.scene_heading: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT #5-3#
segments.time: Night, warm lamp light against the cool city glow
segments.first_state: Camera on the front-wall side by the low TV console, facing the floor-to-ceiling windows on the back wall; the axis runs from the pale sofa to the marble island of the open kitchen. Lin Qingyu sits slouched on the long pale-oatmeal sofa, which stands on the patterned rug with its back to the left wall, facing the kitchen. Ji Ran, in her black satin slip dress, stands on the open floor between the marble-and-glass coffee table and the marble island, facing him, arms folded. There is one marble-and-glass coffee table in front of the sofa, one brass arc floor lamp beside the sofa and three bar stools at the island.

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV console facing the windows
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu leans back on the pale sofa. Ji Ran, arms folded, faces him across the marble-and-glass coffee table from the kitchen side, the night city glittering behind the windows.
shots.audio: <Quiet room tone, distant city hum>

shots.camera: Medium shot, dirty single, high angle over Lin Qingyu's shoulder from the sofa toward the kitchen island
shots.visual: Ji Ran looks down at Lin Qingyu with her arms folded and one eyebrow raised, the back of his head at the frame edge.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Mandarin, cool, skeptical): {你面试都没通过，这次来想干嘛？}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV console side angled toward the sofa
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu sits up straight on the sofa, rests his forearms on his knees and lifts his eyes to meet Ji Ran's.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, low angle, slow push in on Lin Qingyu, from the kitchen side of the coffee table
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran's gaze with a calm, earnest look and a hint of a smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Mandarin, warm, firm): {我来争取一个试用期。}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on Ji Ran's face, slow push in, eye level, from the sofa side
shots.visual: Ji Ran's lips part slightly and her folded arms loosen as soft light and snowlike flecks drift across the image.

segments.light_audio: Cool night city glow through the floor-to-ceiling windows, warm brass arc floor lamp, ceiling cove light and the kitchen pendant; quiet room tone and distant city hum.

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 你面试都没通过，这次来想干嘛？

must_hit: Ji Ran stands arms folded opposite Lin Qingyu seated on the sofa
Lin Qingyu sits up and asks for a probation period
Soft light and snowlike flecks drift across the final image
segments.exit_state: Camera on the front-wall side by the TV console. Lin Qingyu sits upright on the pale-oatmeal sofa, forearms on his knees, looking up at Ji Ran. Ji Ran stands on the open floor between the coffee table and the marble island, facing him, her arms loosening, soft snowlike flecks drifting over the image.
